desc:
🛠️ Welcome to Build to Survive Block City!, the game where you can build anything you can imagine! Whether it's the house 🏠, castle, or fort of your dreams, you've come to the right place! Build with your friends to survive in this wondrous city!

💾 Everything autosaves!
🤝 Invite your friends to build together!
💥 Survive the disasters!

👍 Like the game for more updates! 👍

🎮 CONTROLS 🎮
R - Rotate Object
T - Turn Object (Only Small Objects)
Q - Swap between hammer and current object
F - Toggle Camera Mode
Z/X - Rotate Camera
